tasks.title: Conversation #107
tasks.transcript:
Woman: Are you all set for the company award ceremony tomorrow? I hear it's going to be spectacular.
Man: Not yet. Everything looks good in the auditorium, but I still need to pick up some food and drinks.
Woman: I can help you with that. I was just on my way to the supermarket.
Man: That would be great.
Woman: Just give me a list and I'll head out.

questions.stem: What has the man been doing?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男士一直在做什么？ 定位原文：Man: Everything looks good in the auditorium, but I still need to pick up some food and drinks. （结合女士问的“company award ceremony tomorrow”） 选项分析： A. Cleaning up after a picnic 野餐后打扫卫生。对话中未提及野餐，所以A选项错误。 B. Preparing for a celebration 为庆祝活动做准备。男士在检查礼堂（auditorium）并准备食物和饮料，为明天的公司颁奖典礼做准备，颁奖典礼属于庆祝活动，所以B选项正确。 C. Taking an inventory of supplies 清点物资库存。男士提到礼堂看起来不错，但并未说他在清点库存，所以C选项错误。 D. Attending a professional conference 参加专业会议。对话中未提及会议，男士是在为明天的活动做准备，并非正在参加会议，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What will the woman probably do next?

options.D: Look over a list of award recipients

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：女士接下来很可能会做什么？ 定位原文：Woman: I can help you with that. I was just on my way to the supermarket. / Just give me a list and I’ll head out. 选项分析： A. Shop for food and drinks 购买食物和饮料。女士主动提出帮忙，说她正要去超市，让男士给她清单她就出发，所以A选项正确。 B. Reserve a meeting venue 预订会议场地。对话中场地（auditorium）已经准备好了，无需预订，所以B选项错误。 C. Set up a conference room 布置会议室。女士去超市是买食物和饮料，而不是布置房间，所以C选项错误。 D. Look over a list of award recipients 查看获奖者名单。对话中未提及获奖者名单，所以D选项错误。
